First Timers Cancellation Policy The Well Labs+ Blog FAQ’s Financing Contact Virtual Consultation Book Now The CoolSculpting Center of New England About Face — A Well Labs+ Medspa in Stratham, New Hampshire is the CoolSculpting® Center of New England, and we strive to provide individualized treatment plans customized to your aesthetic goals. We are proud to offer CoolSculpting , the global leader in non-surgical fat reduction. You’ll appreciate our personal touch as soon as you arrive. BOOK A CONSULTATION Our Facility We are pleased to bring you unsurpassed service in our state-of-the-art facility, the first CoolSculpting and body contouring facility for area clients. You’ll be greeted by our warm, professional staff where your experience begins. At About Face — A Well Labs+ Medspa, more than 3,000 men and women have chosen CoolSculpting for safe, comfortable, and permanent elimination of fat cells. CoolSculpting and its next generation, CoolAdvantage, were designed by researchers at Boston’s Massachusetts General Hospital. These procedures freeze fat cells through a process called apoptosis. Our Promise to You At The CoolSculpting Center of New England As CoolSculpting Master Providers, we pride ourselves on providing a professional, private environment for this procedure. We can target treatment to meet your desired results, with the ability to remove fat deposits from the knees, thighs, back, flanks, abdomen, and submental region (under the chin). At the CoolSculpting Center of New England, we promise our clients: Free, honest consultations with a treatment plan and pricing customized just for you. No hidden costs. Efficient treatment times. We know how busy you are, so we have dual machines that can treat two areas at once to make the best use of your time. We offer flexible hours to best accommodate your busy schedule. In our serene treatment room, you can stream your favorite shows, work on your computer, or simply enjoy a nap. Some patients enjoy doing multiple treatment areas over a few hours. If you prefer this arrangement, we’ll make sure you’re well-nourished and hydrated throughout your treatment. We create a partnership you can trust. We are committed to your results and will recommend the best services for your needs. Our team will monitor your progress from start to finish, and we’re available to answer your questions as they arise. CoolSculpting Before & Afters Explore real patient transformations and see how CoolSculpting can help reduce stubborn fat in areas that often resist diet and exercise.
